# Problem 1
```{r}
#install.packages("palmerpenguins")
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

#try to describe the data
```{r}
nrow(penguins)
ncol(penguins)
```
#from the result, we can see there is 344 rows and 8 columns for this dataset

```{r}
names(penguins)
```
#The dataset contains information about penguins, including species, island, bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year.

```{r}
mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
```
#The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.
